concepts.gloss_en: The greatness of the Creator (the divine attribute/reality itself)
The revelation/manifestation of the greatness of the Creator — the process of disclosing it (achieved via charity to a worthy poor person), not the greatness itself

members.note: representative; construct head is התגלות (revelation of), a distinct action/state about גדלות הבורא — per rule 4 not the same concept

notes: Both appear in lm1:25 and are closely linked in the passage, but the second names the act of revealing the greatness (via tzedakah), while the first names the greatness itself. Kept separate per rule 4 (action/state about X ≠ X).
